﻿# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: hamcrest-library 1.3 -> 2.2

## Context

Project `jcabi-http` (by jcabi) has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`org.hamcrest:hamcrest-library` from `1.3` to `2.2` (major update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/jcabi/jcabi-http/pull/366

## Your Task

The source code is in `/jcabi-http`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.
I'll help you fix the compilation failure caused by the Hamcrest upgrade. Let me start by understanding the current state of the project and identifying the compilation errors.

arguments.description: Run Maven compile to see compilation errors

steps.message:
Let me check what the actual class names are in Hamcrest 2.2. In Hamcrest 2.x, the structure changed:
- `org.hamcrest.CoreMatchers` - core matchers like `not()`, `nullValue()`, etc.
- `org.hamcrest.Matchers` - this is a class that extends CoreMatchers and adds more (it actually DOES exist in 2.2)
- `org.hamcrest.beans.HasProperty` for `hasProperty`
- For `emptyIterable()`, it should be in CoreMatchers
